name: Nexus Integration Haptic Feedback Gloves
description:
Full-hand gloves with a dense array of haptic actuators that simulate physical sensation when interacting with virtual or holographic objects. The wearer can feel the weight, texture, and resistance of digital objects as though they were real. Calibration takes approximately thirty seconds per user.

Used in holographic design studios, remote surgery training, and high-end gaming environments. The Haptic Feedback Gloves bridge the gap between the digital and physical in a way that makes virtual interaction feel substantive rather than performative.
functionality: Virtual object tactile simulation, gesture tracking, adaptive calibration
what_it_says: You work with things that don't physically exist and your hands need to believe they do.
story_hooks: A designer's Haptic Feedback Gloves begin registering touch sensations from objects that aren't in their holographic workspace — something is pushing back from the other side of the display.
